args.title: Correct handling of transactions with different currencies in src/export/csv.ts
args.body: This pull request addresses a bug in `src/export/csv.ts` where transactions with the same date, amount, and description but differing currencies (e.g., one in EUR and the other in USD) are merged into a single entry in the exported CSV. After version 3.2.0, when transactions started including currency, this issue became apparent. The proposed change ensures that all transactions are accurately represented in the CSV output, regardless of their currency, preserving essential transaction information for the user.
